utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the timing and where we’re dropping everything off first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure — we’re meeting at the community shed at 9, then heading to the drop-off point by the school right after.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I’ll plan to be at the shed by 9 and follow along to the school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times if that makes the repair drive easier. What time are they thinking?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, thanks. I’m not sure on the exact time yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just send me the time when you get it, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive need most?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve mostly just heard bits and pieces, so I’m not the best source. But I can ask around and bring you the latest I can find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — that’d help a lot. Just give me the main needs when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Could you bring a few basic tools and some sturdy boxes? If you have any spare gloves or packing tape, those would help a lot too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring basic tools, sturdy boxes, and any spare gloves and packing tape I have.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. If you need a hand, I can stop by and help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rey — I might take you up on that. I usually end up joining late, but I can still help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just let me know what time works for you. Even a little help would make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t seen the repair drive details yet—can you point me to the exact item or message? I want to make sure I check the right thing before we act.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — I’ll check the drive and send you the exact item or message. If it’s easier, I can also summarize the key details once I find it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that would help — please send the exact item or message first, and then I can review the details carefully.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m still a little fuzzy, but I want to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear — I’ll send you the details and you can jump in wherever it’s easiest for you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — send it over when you can, and I’ll do my best to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Mara — could you help track the needed supplies and check in with volunteers for the pickup list?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rosa — I can track the supplies and check in with the volunteers for the pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is set up—if you want, I can help make sure we’ve got the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal — is it by the community hall again, or did they move it somewhere else?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—I haven’t confirmed the new spot. I’ll check and let you know if it moved from the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands. If I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep the plan in mind and check back with you soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m heading out now, so I’ll see what I can hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I think I heard something about that. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You did hear about it, right? I’m just trying to confirm the details before I say anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I heard a little about it, but I might be missing the details. What do you need me to confirm?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Eli — what kind of help do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: a clear list of what needs fixing, then we can sort it by priority.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll jot down the fixes and sort them from most urgent to least urgent.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s keep it simple and stick to a clear plan for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps. I just want to make sure we’ve got the timing and pickup details sorted so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — let’s set the pickup time first, then list the items and keep a little buffer so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’m heading out on errands and can check around the neighborhood for news about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—can you confirm if you hear anything about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just point me to the main need and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — we’re short on screws, wood glue, and a couple of replacement hinges. If you can grab any of those, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can grab the screws and wood glue today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m Rosa — I’ve got the repair drive notes organized and I’m happy to help get things moving. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — please send me the repair list and tell me which jobs need doing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair list over now and flag the urgent jobs first. If you want, I can also sort them by priority and neighborhood block.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the sign-in table? That would really take some pressure off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the sign-in table. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great — I’m going to start telling folks about the repair drive right away. I’ll make sure everyone near the block gets the invite.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll keep it moving and let the block know today. If you want, I can also help gather a few more neighbors for it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet — I’d like to check where the repair drive is being held first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — if you hear where it’s set up, let me know and I can swing by too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll check the location and tell you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to drop by and help out. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — if you can bring a hammer, some screws, and a tape measure, that’d help a lot. I’ll be at the drive setting things up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — hammer, screws, and a tape measure. I’ll swing by soon and bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m in—happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me, Noah?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — honestly, I’m still sorting out the details. I’ll let you know as soon as I remember what we need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — just ping me when you’ve got the list, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting organized, and folks are already pitching in. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they need next.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. If they need any tools or a hand, I’m happy to lend both.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet, Gus — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what they’re short on. That kind of help always goes a long way around here.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’m checking the details first. What do we know about the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not much yet — just that it’s for repairs, and I’d like to know what needs fixing and when they’re planning to do it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help with that — let’s pin down what needs fixing and the timing first. Do we know who’s organizing it or where the repairs will happen?
